notes.title: New Tilesets: KR Tribal Fort, Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm + Pack Updates
notes.content:
Two new tilesets for RPG Maker! A new Tribal Fort set from Kokoro Reflections! A new Farm Add-on for Winlu Fantasy! Plus tons of updates to existing packs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699140/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Tribal_Fort_Tileset/

Build a protected village for your orc heroine to live in with the KR Tribal Fort Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a MV/MZ-sized tileset ready to help you build wooden huts and thick log walls to keep the village safe from deadly monsters and dangerous adventurers! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 5 B sheets are ready to build exteriors and interiors filled with all the spikes, skulls, and weaponry an orc could wish for. Create buildings with wooden logs tied together with ropes and decorated with bones, and mark the chief’s home with draped red cloth off its roof. Create arenas for the villagers to train in with curved walls of logs, or mark combat areas with large curved bone and set up an armory hut filled with gnarly weapons nearby so fights are always fair. Let your heroes recover in rooms with roughly hammered together shelves and beds made from animal hides, and lock troublemakers up in wooden cages!

This pack also includes character sprites for log gates, a wooden treasure chest, a cloth curtain to use as a door, and rotating meat that you can set up over a campfire. Reward your players patience by having the raw meat they stick over the fire turn into a stat-boosting roasted meal, and stop your players from leaving the village too early by keeping the massive wooden gates firmly closed until they’re properly equipped. If your orc heroine needs a strong place to call home, or you want to give your adventurers a new place to challenge orcs and goblins, pick up the KR Tribal Fort Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699160/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Exterior_Addon_Farm_Tiles/

Give your players a lovely farm to run when they’re not off adventuring with the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack! Winlu is back with another addition to their Fantasy Exterior series, this time focusing on healthy plants and rustic charm to turn any houses you’ve already built into a working farm. 1 B sheet includes wood and thatch angled roofs to build barns, and short stone walls to keep your wheat fields separate from your livestock. Chicken coops and feed troughs are perfect for keeping your animals fed and safe, and some scattered piles of hay can add to the feeling that this is a busy farm with a working windmill.

And once you’ve set up the map, add more life to your farm with this pack’s character sprites! Have white and brown cows wander a grassy field where they can be milked, and give pigs some treats in the hopes of them digging up some useful items. Chickens can offer eggs (just watch out for the aggressive rooster!), and swarms of bees can be carefully followed back to their hive to gather healing honey. If animals aren’t your hero’s focus, then fill the fields with wheat, corn, and sunflowers that all grow and await harvesting. Smaller plots can grow carrots, cabbages, turnips, grapes, pumpkins, and tomatoes that your heroes could sell for extra cash, and let your heroes smash the rocks that appear in the fields to possibly find gold or silver ore. Pick up the Winlu Fantasy Exterior Add-on Farm Tiles pack and add some money-making farms to your towns and villages!

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ has been updated to v1.9.0
notes.content:
RPG Maker MZ has been updated to version 1.9.0.
The update contents are as follows:

[list]
[*]Added Character Generator assets in dlc/BasicResources/generator folder. Import the assets following the steps written in a text file which exists in the same folder.
[*]Face and icon images can now be selected from multiple size standards, supporting asset standards from the previous series.
[*]In the database [System 2] - [Editor Settings] - [Message Width], you can now change the position of the guideline for a new line break displayed in the "Show Text" event command. It is specified by the number of characters. It supports both cases with and without a face image.
[*]You can now exclude specific files during deployment. You can exclude files/folders that match the extensions specified in "Exclude extensions" and the names specified in "Exclude files/folders" (include the extension for files) to export the game folder.
[*]In the database [System 2] - [Advanced Settings] - [Pictures Upper Limit], you can now change the maximum number of pictures. You can set up to 500.
[*]When you select "Save as Image" by right-clicking on the map, you can now set four levels of reduction scale. In addition, it is now possible to export an image at the same magnification even for large maps of 64x64 or more.
[*]The amount of Parameter Changes for weapons/armors can now be set up to -9999 to 9999 for Max HP and Max MP, and -999 to 999 for other parameters.
[*]There is no longer a coordinate limit when placing enemies in "Troops". If you place it off-screen and cannot click it, use "Align" to reset it.
[*]In all text boxes where control characters can be used, you can now select "Insert Control Character", "Insert Color Number" and "Insert Icon Number" when you right-click.
[*]When you specify a Switch/Variable in "Event Searcher", the search results now include events where they are used in the Conditions.
[*]In "Plugin Manager", the scroll position when it was last opened is now restored.
[*]In the database [System 2] - [Editor Settings] - [JSON Format Level], you can now select the formatting level of the JSON files output by MZ from three levels. Put 0 for no formatting. Put 1 for the minimum length that creates a new line at every data unit (same as before version 1.8.1). Put 2 for the maximum length that creates a new line at every comma or bracket.
[*]You can now select maps on a map selector dialog by specifying "map" or "location" for the annotation "@type" of the plugin parameter. If you specify "map" for @type, the ID of the selected map will be set as its value. If you specify "location", you can select a map and the coordinates on the map and an object (string) containing the map ID, X coordinate and Y coordinate will be set as its value. ex) {"mapId":"1","x":"0","y":"0"}
[*]When "file" is specified in the annotation "@type" of the plugin parameter, you can now specify the "movies" folder as the value of "@dir".
[*]Fixed an issue that the scroll bar could not be moved when using a touch screen (such as an LCD tablet) on Mac.
[*]Fixed an issue that the scroll bar movement status was stored when another event editor was opened with the scroll bar moved horizontally in the event editor.
[*]Fixed an issue that when there was a map that existed on the map tree but its data file did not exist and you deploy with "Exclude Unused Fils" enabled, the actually used assets were unintentionally deleted.
[*]Fixed an issue that when "%1" was entered in the message of a newly created Skills/States and restarted MZ, an extra "%2" was inserted.
[*]Updated Launch plugins "AltMenuScreen2MZ.js", "AnimationMv.js", "BattleVoiceMZ.js", "DevToolsManage.js", "EventMovableLimitation.js", "EventReSpawn.js", "ItemCombinationMZ.js", "MessageWindowPopup.js", "NovelMessageMZ.js", "ShakeOnDamage.js", "SmartAutoBattle.js" and "TemplateEvent.js" (\dlc\BasicResources\plugins\launch folder).
[/list]

notes.title: New DLC: Galefire Characters - NPC Monster Pack 2, KR Legendary Palace - Wendigo
notes.content:
More characters from Michael Galefire! More tiles from Kokoro Reflections!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409180/RPG_Maker_MZ__Galefire_Characters__NPC_Pack_2/

Talk to new friends and foes with Galefire Characters - NPC Monster Pack 2! Michael Galefire is back with another picture pack with 16 characters to add more oomph to your cutscenes. Give your shopping district some memorable NPCs with a cool armored halfling in sunglasses offering up powerful guns for a fair price and a grinning goblin welder ready to upgrade your hero’s armor if you bring him the right supplies. Accept side quests to help out the city from a hulking mechanized guard, or learn secrets of magic from figures wearing cloaks that don’t quite hide their curved horns. For the more adventurous of heroes, have them try to talk to the enormous green-armored alien Swarm Queen and her attack dogs before the battle begins to learn where their hive is, and duel a knight wielding weapons made of magic with words first to see if your heroes can avoid a challenging fight!

Each image is in a high resolution so you can easily resize it to perfectly fix your screen size, or shrink down the monsters for comedic effect! Reveal that the Terra Terror wyrm that’s been terrorizing a town is actually only a foot tall, or shrink your heroes down to explore new areas and show their smaller size by having all the NPC pictures be huge. If your cities have been needing new shopkeepers and your plotlines have been lacking some deadly armored foes, pick up the Galefire Characters - NPC Monster Pack 2!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409190/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palace__Wendigo_Tileset/

Visit your hero’s bloodiest nightmares with the KR Legendary Palace - Wendigo Tileset! Kokoro Reflections continues their Legendary Palace series with a set of tiles stained crimson where not only do the walls have eyes, but they’re watching you! A1, A2, A4, A5, and B tiles are ready to coat your maps with different shades of red to create a truly terrible dungeon filled with ponds of blood and shattered bones. Start your heroes in a room with textured brown walls and floor that could be mistaken for dirt, though the bruised purple stains on the floor and streams of blood leaking from next to the doorway suggests something far darker. As they delve deeper and deeper into the monstrous lair replace the floors with clumped fat that squelches when stepped on and fibrous red muscle walls where veins curve together to form decorations and statues. Reward your players for facing the blood splattered rooms instead of racing for the exit with a scarlet treasure chest character sprite, and add a bit of unsettling movement to the halls with a drop of blood sprite that can fall from the ceiling into a bloody puddle.

This pack also includes sample maps for MV and MZ, so you can see each tile’s passability and gain inspiration for how to make each map as horrific as possible. Pick up the KR Legendary Palace - Wendigo Tileset and scare your heroes and players alike with bloody hallways and deadly throne rooms!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Peaceful Rest Graveyard Tileset, Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Swamp
notes.content:
Two new tilesets to take you into the dark swamp, and even spookier graveyard!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195870/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Peaceful_Rest_Graveyard_Tileset/

Share a somber farewell with a beloved party member or hunt ghouls in the dead of night with the KR Peaceful Rest Graveyard Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has a new MV/MZ-sized tileset designed to help you create exterior maps filled with tombstones and crypts. Create an intimate gathering for family to say goodbye to your hero before she suddenly revives in the coffin, send your party to explore a cursed cemetery where the ponds are filled with blood, restore a small family plot long forgotten in the center of a rosebush hedge maze, and more with this pack!

A1, A2, and A4 tiles along with 3 B sheets can build all sorts of cozy or spooky cemeteries. Create stone paths weaving between tall headstones and patches of bright yellow flowers, or keep things simple with dirt paths that lead to new graves where the shovels are still next to them and a small bouquet of flowers show that it has a daily visitor. Keep unwanted troublemakers out of the grounds with wrought iron fences, and set up folding chairs under a black canopy for families to gather when saying goodbye. Ruined versions of the tombstones, fences, and flowers can help show just how long it has been since the last person had visited a grave, or destroy a village’s graveyard if the heroes don’t defeat a necromancer in time! So if your game needs a creepy cemetery or you want a calm area where your heroes can remind themselves why they fight, pick up the KR Peaceful Rest Graveyard Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195880/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Fantasy_Tileset__Swamp/

Send your heroes deep into bogs where solid ground meanders through noxious water and ancient castle walls collapse into nearby sludge with the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Swamp pack! Winlu is back with another tileset for your MV/MZ games, this time filled with all the greens and browns your swampland and marshes could need. A1, A2, and A5 tiles along with 5 B sheets (4 for exteriors and 1 for interiors) are filled with creepy twisted trees and muddy autotiles to create semi-safe paths between pools of brown, blue, green, or purple water so you can show the area becoming more deadly as your heroes journey deeper into the swamp. Have your heroes follow wooden pathways over lilypad-filled waters and mushrooms growing out of sticky mud until they reach the wooden huts that make up a swamp hag village. Step inside a wooden house grown straight from the ground and gather the bowls of important ingredients all while trying to avoid becoming dinner!

This pack also includes 12 character sheets filled with decorations to help add even more life to your swamps! Have tattered and stained banners flutter in the breeze while lanterns hung from wooden posts offer an eerie green light to help your heroes stay on the path. Block off the witch’s hut with a gate formed of magically grown branches that can only be opened by activating skulls with clattering jaws hidden around the swamp, and sink a wooden treasure chest into the murky waters while bubbles of unknown gasses rise from below and burst. Pick up the Winlu Fantasy Tileset - Swamp pack and send your heroes on a wild adventure to save a cursed princess or just add a new gorgeous area for your players to explore!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Luxury Hotel and Casino Tileset, A Long Goodbye Song Pack
notes.content:
A new tileset for high rollers from Kokoro Reflections! A new music pack to bring your scenes to life from Ayato Sound Create!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844200/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Luxury_Hotel_and_Casino_Tileset/

Help your heroes relax after a day of dungeon exploration with the KR Luxury Hotel and Casino Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is back with another interior tileset, this time offering golden autotiles and gilded furniture to build opulent casinos and hotel rooms. Let your heroes try their luck with slot machines, test their skills at poker and roulette tables, and get some sleep after a few hours of minigames with this pack!

A1, A2, and A4 tiles along with 2 B sheets (and some extra couches for all your lounge needs) are ready to help you build blackjack parlors with round gilded inlays on the floor and large windows let light in so people know when they’ve spent all day at the tables. Build a nice hotel with red curtains and large chandeliers that hang over each room’s huge tub, and have a black-topped bar with a variety of drinks and meals available to order. And if your game takes place in a modern setting? Don’t forget to include an ATM or two and some security cameras so that your heroes know no funny business is allowed! This pack also includes double doors with spirals of gold and a spout of water for a fountain to add some extra decadence in the casino’s lobby. Pick up the KR Luxury Hotel and Casino Tileset and give your heroes a nice place to rest and somewhere to spend all their extra gold!

notes.title: New DLC: 4 Fantasy Dreamland Packs!
notes.content:
Many of us making games are trying to build our fantasy dreamland, and Elv Games is here to help with their Fantasy Dreamland series of pixel tilesets!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235970/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland__Starter_Pack/

Give your RPG the perfect pixelated makeover with the Fantasy Dreamland - Starter Pack! Elv Games is here with an incredible pack filled with tiles, sprites, and more to help make your dream game world a reality. This pack’s 44 tilesets (including A1, A2, A5, and a variety of B sheets) cover important locations for your beginner hero; with tiles devoted to villages, grasslands, caves, and deserts you know that your player won’t get bored exploring! Create hot cactus-filled deserts, cheerful grasslands overflowing with flowers, welcoming villages, and curious caves filled with minerals and maybe even a secret blacksmith with this pack’s tilesets.

An incredible world to explore is useless without anyone living in it, which is why this pack also includes a bunch of humanoid and monster sprites! 40 humanoid sprites (including goblins/elves and beastmen) are ready to wander your villages or offer items to your heroes while they search for new dungeons. Or use them to create an all-powerful adventuring party! Monster sprites for slimes, mushrooms and plant critters, and fire elementals can add some movement to a map or act as on-map enemies, and each monster has a damaged version for when they’ve been defeated or are taking a nap. Each humanoid and monster sprite also comes with a matching SV battler, so you’re ready to take your battle screen to the next level!

Also included are a bunch of icons to really help sell the retro feel of your game. Fill your menus with icons for weapons, armor, items, and dungeon keys, or use them in messages to help get your point across! This pack comes ready to use in both Vx/Ace and MV/MZ sizes, so you can enjoy these tiles even if you prefer the older engines. So if you’ve been searching for an adorable pixel art style or want a wider variety of monster sprites, pick up the Fantasy Dreamland - Starter Pack today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2236010/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland_Adventurer_Pack/

Love the Fantasy Dreamland style, but wish there were even more options? Then check out the Fantasy Dreamland Adventure Pack! Elv Games has tiles and sprites for two new locations to explore: lush forests and lava-filled mountains! Create verdant maps full of trees and flowering grasses where your heroes can hunt for resources, or choose more mystical blue, purple, and red-leafed trees to turn a simple forest into dark woods or the entrance to a fairy village. A wide selection of long grasses, flowers, and mushrooms are perfect for keeping the ground from looking too boring, or use them to mark fairy rings or buried treasures! Or send your heroes up a mountainside with three different ground colors and a selection of stones, from pebbles to boulders, to decorate the barren location. Use the pack’s carved tablets along the mountain paths to cheer your heroes forward, or leave them as warning of a deadly foe ahead! Of course, you could always mix and match to create a tree-covered volcano or a suspicious quarry in the middle of an otherwise pleasant forest.

Tiles aren’t the only thing you’ll find in this pack! Sprites for treasure chests, glowing flowers, and moving puddles of lava in stones are perfect for adding some little details, and 30 enemy sprites ready to add some life to your maps. Get ready to deal with living rocks, insect-like critters, and gooey blobs ready to swallow up unsuspecting adventurers!

Each enemy also comes with a damaged sprite, perfect for once you’ve beaten them or as a surprise for your players, and an animated SV battler, so you could face them on the battlefield or turn them into a helpful friend! And if that wasn’t enough, this pack comes presized for both VX/Ace and MV/MZ, so you can just drop the files into your project and get started building your world. Send your adventurers to fantastical forests and monstrous mountains with the Fantasy Dreamland Adventure Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271690/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland_Casual_Pack/

Let your heroes visit a modern metropolis and a snowy, cabin-filled town with the Fantasy Dreamland Casual Pack! Elv Games is back with another pack filled to the brim of adorable pixel art, this time focusing on two drastically different places: steel-filled cities and snow-covered villages. Build a concrete jungle for your heroes to explore as they try their best to run a small shop, and send your fantasy heroes to a winter wonderland where frosted trees stand near warm log cabins. 20 sheets of tiles, covering A1, A2, A5, and B sheets give you ample choices for ground and building colors. Build dark gray skyscrapers next to waterways while red-roofed shops line the street near a park filled with swings and teeter-totters, or create a quiet mountain retreat nestled between snowy rocks and trees. Fill your cities with helpful signs pointing the way and add some pops of color and nature with trees and flowers placed in planters. Or create a calm village where footprints in the snow are the only sign of people living there.

This pack also includes 40 unique human characters, perfect for populating your cities and padding out your party! Each person comes with a SV Battler, so they’re ready to fight at any time. There are also animated doors and treasure chests, so your heroes can search snow-covered barrels or rush through a glass door to heal at a hotel. Meet new NPCs in shining cities and chilly villages with the Fantasy Dreamland Casual Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271700/RPG_Maker_MZ__Fantasy_Dreamland_Explorer_Pack/

Send your players deep into deadly dungeons and squelching through damp marshes with the Fantasy Dreamland Explorer Pack! Elv Games’ cute pixel art style is here to help you create some spookier locations, with tiles to make underground dungeons and swamplands for your heroes to explore! 13 tileset sheets offer up dangerous and dark tiles that are perfect for making a challenging dungeon. Have your heroes get lost in a swamp where dark green grass and shallow water turns into a rocky region where dead trees are the only sign of plant life, or let them escape a castle dungeon only to find themselves lost in a forgotten kingdom’s underground maze where chains on the wall and diagonal walls dropping into bottomless pits hint at a dark history. Variations in ground tiles make it easy to keep a map from feeling one-note, and smaller tiles like ruined furniture, stepping stones, and tree stumps are perfect details for helping your players keep track of where they’ve been while exploring.

Just so you don’t accidentally leave your dungeons and swamps empty, this pack also includes 5 large monsters that can act as bosses, each with 4 color variations. Battle against (or with) stacked shrooms and bloodstained floating eyeballs thanks to matching SV Battlers, and let your players see the proof of their win with a downed sprite for every monster! Give your players options when it comes to exploring dungeons by letting them fight a diamond-headed golem or solve a puzzle to get past trap spikes and locked doors, or challenge them to do both for extra rewards! Battle against fearsome monsters and solve ancient puzzles in underground tombs with the Fantasy Dreamland Explorer Pack!

This pack also includes 9 sheets of doors (for a whopping 216 choices!) to give your players access to all the shop’s rooms. Enter the shop through doors decorated with shiny pink glass, and hide employee-only areas behind white wooden doors. Don’t forget to include a bathroom, with plain doors decorated only with a sign! Let your players take a date to the candy store, work behind the counter, or just stop in for a sweet healing item with the KR Candy Shop Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2151250/RPG_Maker_MZ__RED_MUSIC_PACK_4/

Gee-kun-soft’s latest music pack features 10 beautiful orchestral tunes to ground your cutscenes and prepare your players for what’s to come. With tracks for battles, exploration, and emotional cutscenes, you’re sure to find a track to fall in love with in this pack!

Give the final fights different battle tracks, with 3 different tracks intended for challenging fights. Pick one that gives your players a boost of confidence thanks to powerful trumpets to help them defeat the demon lord’s guards, and give the demon lord his own track with steady drums and a cacophony of strings and brass. Search ancient ruins or a destroyed city while a lonely guitar plays in the background, eventually joined by other soft instruments when your heroes discover just what happened there. If your heroes are giving an impassioned speech to scared soldiers, grab a track with soaring melodies to help raise the mood and morale of not just the NPCs but also your players! 

When it’s finally time to rest, let a music box play a soft melody as your heroes return home to their loved ones. notes.title: New DLC: Never Ever Clean Up Tileset, Odyssey of Fantasy: Enemy Pack
notes.content:
Sometimes, you get busy on your projects and things get a bit messy... well this release day we have a tileset to make maps in your game messy, plus a whole mess of new enemies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003830/RPG_Maker_MZ__Never_Ever_Clean_Up_Tileset/

Do you think your interior maps are too clean? Have you been trying to show that someone skips chores or that a place has been abandoned? Then it’s time to check out the Never Ever Clean Up Tileset! Wataru Nakanami has created decorative tiles for MV and MZ that can help add even more humanity to your maps with kitchen knick-knacks, hobby items, and more. The pack includes a filled B sheet for fantasy worlds and one for modern stories, making it easy to find the perfect addition no matter your game!

Grab the fantasy sheet to help stock a doctor’s office with shiny metal tools and stacks of books that haven’t been properly placed back in the bookcase, or a seamstress’s room with a wooden spinning wheel and old-fashioned sewing machine. Create the home of a gardener filled with potted plants and tools hanging on the wall, all lit by the soft glow of colorful lanterns. There are also translucent windows that you can add to certain shelves that can help tell stories all on their own. Have expensive books locked away behind closed panels, or show that thieves have already been here by having shattered glass in front of empty shelves. 

A modern setting can use the other sheet to turn boring rooms into filled apartments. Give your gamer NPC a multi-screen computer setup, with all of their electronics plugged into the closest outlet. Or give a home chef a proper kitchen with dark marble countertops and a four-burner range. This sheet includes two versions of certain tiles (clean and dirty), making it easy to show that some teens threw a party while their parents were away and forgot to clean up the pizza boxes, or just how much effort your hero went to turn a disgusting apartment into a livable place. And if all those tiles weren’t enough, this pack also includes some sprites to bring some gross and grimy movement to your maps! Have cockroaches run around the ground when your heroes explore the city sewers, or show that a room is disgusting by having swarms of flies and writhing maggots near rotting food. So if you’ve been thinking your maps are a touch too sterile, or just want to add some grime to your lazy NPCs’ rooms, pick up the Never Ever Clean Up Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621342/RPG_Maker_MZ__Odyssey_of_Fantasy_enemy_pack/

Better look closely to find out which element you need to resist, they could possess fire, water, thunder, grass or darkness powers!

And in the same fashion as the goblins, there is also a full orc tribe ready for your heroes visit! And the pattern of those five elements is woven into the whole pack, not only do the orc wizards fight with those as well, but there are also several other elemental creatures in here that have their own unique version for each element: There are cute elemental orbs, but also hauntingly beautiful female elemental spirits and dragons.

The whole set is rounded up by various ents, from a small stump to a normal sized one with a bushy crown to a bare one to a giant old one wielding spiritual powers plus more dragons, such as a baby dragon, a general dragon leading the armies of evil and a powerful yet elegant royal while king dragon. Build multiple towns with different building styles and groundcover thanks to well-stocked A1, A2, A3, A4, and A5 tilesets, along with diagonal roofs to help you make more interestingly shaped houses. This pack also includes animated decorations such as rotating water wheels, glowing lanterns, and banners that flutter in the wind to help bring your maps to life. Let a flame flicker in the town’s forge, and give each building a fitting door or gate with more than 10 to choose from! Give your lab’s different areas unique looks by wielding 12 brown-tinged walls and wooden and concrete floors together with a selection of dirty details like rusty edges or rubble to make rooms at different stages of disrepair. Once your rooms are squared away, add in counters where you can store all of your scientists’ tools! Medical journals, note-covered papers, beakers and flasks filled with unknown liquids, microscopes, and even a brain in a jar can help your players judge exactly what type of person runs the lab. Beyond those modern tools, there is also a wide selection of machinery and sci-fi technology glows with an alien green tint, just what you need to explain where all the vicious chimera or robot enemies are coming from.

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ 1.4.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello RPG Makers!

The latest update, Version 1.4.4 is live! 

Thank you for using RPG Maker MZ. As always, we appreciate your support! 
We hope you are enjoying it so far.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a countermeasure to the problem that may cause the NW.js process to not terminate normally in Windows environment.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the cursor position would move to a different page when any frame was selected in “Create MV- compatible data” and the frame was deleted while editing the frame view.
[*] Fixed an issue in which events would appear at unintended coordinates after switching maps and loading events with “Autorun” events.
[*] Fixed the problem of "File name "None", Volume 90%, Pitch 100%" when "Play SE" is edited in ”Set Movement Route”.
[*] Fixed an issue in which fade-in was not performed when loading data if the project data had been changed.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues in v1.4.4[/h2]
There is an issue where the game does not automatically close after executing Enemy Group -> "Battle Test".
Workaround.
・Please close with "X".
・Restore main.js to a previous version (update the core script).

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
We will share the updating information regarding this issue with you as soon as possible.

[h2]How to update your project(s):[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Create a backup of your project or only its data and js folders.[/b] Updating can sometimes cause your project to break so this is for the safety of your hard work!
[*] Update your project by going to the Main Tool Bar -> Game -> Update Corescript option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38018723/231654061e5d79959bb5829e5427f6ecebebb9f1.png[/img]
Latest Corescript version: [b]1.4.4[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: RPG Maker MZ Planned Upgrades / "RPG Maker MV & Soaring Machinariae ”bundle
notes.content:
[h3]■RPG Maker MZ Planned Upgrades[/h3]

Hello, RPG Makers.

Thank you for your continued journey with the RPG Maker series.

With the excitement of the RPG Maker Festival in full swing, we’d like to take this time to also announce the many thrilling features coming to the latest title in the series, RPG Maker MZ, later this year.

[h3]v1.4.4 (coming soon)[/h3]
-Will implement a countermeasure to the problem that may cause the NW.js process to not terminate normally in Windows environment.
-Will fix an issue in which the cursor position would move to a different page when any frame was selected in “Create MV- compatible data” and the frame was deleted while editing the frame view.
-Will fix an issue in which events would appear at unintended coordinates after switching maps and loading events with “Autorun” events.
-Will fix the problem of "File name "None", Volume 90%, Pitch 100%" when "Play SE" is edited in ”Set Movement Route”.
-Will fix an issue in which fade-in was not performed when loading data if the project data had been changed.
-Will fix an issue in which a weapon with a sealed shield and a weapon set to "Dual Wield" in the traits could be equipped with a weapon with a sealed shield if the dual wielding weapon was equipped first.
-Will fix an issue in which the weapon in the second slot (shield slot) would remain in the event command "Weapon = None" when the feature "Dual Wield" was set.
-Will fix an issue in which the target of HP recovery was taken away when the feature "Substitute" was set.

[h3]v1.5.0 (Spring 2022)[/h3]
-Will add the ability to select tile size from "16", "24", "32", and "48".
-Will add the ability to copy/paste tileset settings by page.
-Will add the ability to switch the shadow pen to draw/erase rectangles by holding down the Shift key.
-Will change the limit on the number of database items.
-Will add the ability to temporarily disable event commands in a specified range.
-Will add "Switch" (assign images of levers, buttons, etc. on the map to any switch number) to Easy Event Creation.
-Will add the ability to add the corresponding event name to the name field in the easy event creation.

We have been listening to your feedback, and we hope you look forward to seeing your opinions shape the future of MZ.

We thank you for this opportunity to further improve RPG Maker MZ with help from all of you.


[h3]■"RPG Maker MV & Soaring Machinariae ”bundle[/h3]

This is a bundle set of the 2D action RPG "Soaring Machinariae" and RPG Maker MV.
*Soaring Machinariae project files and materials that can be used for game production are not included.

About Soaring Machinariae:
A girls' adventure story, told through a traditional action RPG!
Control Iris the Machinariae to explore fields and dungeons, and fight against monsters with sword combos, items, and special moves!

notes.title: RPG Maker Festival: Discounts, Tutorials, Streams, Contests, and More!
notes.content:
Welcome to the RPG Maker Festival Sale! RPG Maker Day is here again, and we’re kicking off a weeklong celebration of all things RPG Maker.

First up, we have an exciting announcement! A new, parallel iteration of RPG Maker is coming: RPG Maker Unite! RPG Maker Unite is based on Unity and contains a stash of new and convenient features to allow users making more compelling games than ever! You can learn more about RPG Maker Unite and wish list it today here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1650950/RPG_MAKER_UNITE/

To continue our celebration of RPG Maker, we would be remiss if we didn’t also celebrate the RPG Maker Community itself!

That is why not only are we having a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rpgmaker_festival]huge sale across all RPG Maker products[/url], we’ve also reached out to devs all around the world who have used RPG Maker to fulfill their dreams of making games to include them in the sale. Check out the full sale page to see tons of fantastic RPG Maker resources, as well as a huge collection of stellar games made by RPG Maker devs on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rpgmaker_festival][b]Be sure to check out the full sale here![/b][/url]

But there are many people in the RPG Maker community who haven’t reached that goal yet. Many people have taken only the first few steps into the wilder world of game making, and are still unsure how to make that dream a reality. And that is where we celebrate one of the best things about the community: All the helping hands out there reaching down to give new users a hand up.

With tutorials, graphic and audio resources, plugins, and just general troubleshooting the community helps take a neophyte maker and turn them into a veteran who can help the next generation of makers.

And that is why on top of the fantastic deals across our RPG Maker products the focus of our RPG Maker Festival will be bringing that same feeling to Steam! Have a tutorial to share? Some resources you’ve made? Or maybe you are here to learn, we have a plethora of events throughout the week for everyone!

[h1]Daily Broadcasts![/h1]

We will be rebroadcasting our Making in MZ Streams as a Marathon starting tonight, and in addition, every day over the next week, we’ll have at least one completely new broadcast for you to watch at the top of the RPG Maker MZ page! RPG Maker tutorials, Game Design advice, and even interviews with some of the most successful RM devs. You can find the full schedule here:

[list]
[*]Monday, Feb 14th, 4:00 PM: Guiding a Player Through Your Maps with Studio Blue
[*]Tuesday, Feb 15th, 4:00 PM: GDD Creation with Studio Blue
[*]Tuesday, Feb 15th, 6:00 PM*: Developer Interview: Rakuen
[*]Wednesday, Feb 16th, 4:00 PM: Developer Interview: Pocket Mirror
[*]Wednesday, Feb 16th, 6:00 PM: Developer Interview: To The Moon
[*]Thursday, Feb 17th, 8:00 PM: Basic Events with Driftwood Gaming
[*]Friday, Feb 18th, 8:00 PM: Basic Database with Driftwood Gaming
[*]Saturday, Feb 19th, 6:00 PM: Developer Interview: Ara Fell
[*]Sunday, Feb 20th, 4:00 PM: How to Format an Autotile with Touchfuzzy
[/list]
All Times in Pacific
*May be delayed if previous stream goes long, will begin directly after.

[h1]Daily Official Guides![/h1]

Every day at 10am Pacific we’ll be posting a new beginner focused Steam guide written by the RPG Maker staff or a veteran member of the community.

Our first guide is already up and can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2753572309]here[/url], be sure to check back in daily to see the next guide!

[h1]Guide Drive![/h1]

We want to see even more guides for RPG Maker MZ in Steam, and to do that, we are holding the RPG Maker Festival Guide Drive! Have a tutorial you’ve written somewhere else, or maybe you want to write a whole new tutorial? Add it into the Steam Guides and be entered to win a prize!

The RPG Maker staff will pick their favorite guide submitted during the Festival week to receive a $25 Steam Gift Card! Additionally, one random guide submitted during the Festival will also win one.

[h1]Resource Drive![/h1]

Do your skills lie more in creating graphics, music, or code than in teaching others? Don’t worry, we have an event for you as well. Let’s fill the MZ Workshop with tons of materials for everyone to use in their game! This will be held just like our Guide Drive. You can submit any materials you created to the Workshop, old or new, as long as it hasn’t been on the MZ workshop before.

Our favorite new resource wins a $25 Steam Gift Card, as well as one random workshop creation uploaded during the drive!

[h1]Festival Map Contest![/h1]

And for the final event of our magnificent festival, we need a festival atmosphere! Create a map with a maximum pixel size of 1920x1080 that you think screams “festival” and submit it as a screenshot. Make sure you have permission to use all the materials you use in your map, and include both the credits and the word “FESTIVAL” in all caps in your screenshot description!

We will award prizes for our top 3 maps!

1st Place: $50 Steam Gift Card
2nd Place: $25 Steam Gift Card
3rd Place: $10 Steam Gift Card

The deadline for this event, and all of the other events in this contest are the end of the sale, on February 21st at 10am Pacific.

So what are you waiting for! Join the week long fun of the RPG Maker Festival! Join in on the contests, watch our broadcasts, and learn even more about how to make your dream game!

notes.title: New DLC: KR Legendary Palaces - Mermaid Tileset, Otani Pixel Fantasy Enemy Vol 3
notes.content:
February has just begun, and it is time for two new RPG Maker packs to make their debut. A second Legendary Palace from Kokoro Reflections, and even more fantastic enemies in the Otani Pixel Fantasy series!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1892130/RPG_Maker_MZ__KR_Legendary_Palaces__Mermaid_Tileset/

Get your scuba gear ready, we are about to dive into an amazing pack that is just waiting for you to explore it! This Kokoro Reflections set from their Legendary Palace series brings you a breathtakingly beautiful Mermaid Palace with everything you need to make it a part of your game.

Has the sea level decreased and this mysterious structure has appeared from it? Or did your heroes actually have to go underwater? No matter how they found it, this impressive place is always worth a visit. With a pearly shimmer on everything, this place is enchantingly beautiful. Maybe the merfolk who lived here are long gone and algae has grown over the place or perhaps it is still inhabited and someone resides on the shell shaped throne. The builders for sure were very crafty people and did a great job at shaping the various detailed statues or mermaids and pillars encrusted with blue gems. Mysterious large snail shells and starfish decorate the site as well as giant mirrors which might be ancient magical artifacts with mystical powers, or maybe they are just nice to look at.

This whole set of course comes with all the needed wall and floor tiles as well plus a matching treasure chest and a ghostly blue flame that might even burn under water. And in case it is not below sea level for you, there are also some beautiful water tiles to surround and further decorate this palace!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874600/RPG_Maker_MZ__Otani_Pixel_Fantasy_Enemy_Pack_Vol3/

Every hero needs a villian to stand up against, an enemy to fight tense battles against to show off their power. The third installation of the Otani Pixel Enemy series comes with a lot of creatures you can use to build challenging fights that look splendid. The ten types of retro style-pixelated battlers come with three unique variations each, totaling to thirty different beings. Those variations are much more than just a recolor, with special additions, details and patterns it is ensured that you know you have a totally different being in front of you, even though it might be from the same family.

For example the giant demons are all fierce horned monstrosities chained to the ground, but while the purple one is just that, the pink one is partly dissolving into thick smoke and the brown one is surrounded by floating rocks. This makes it much easier to assign them to different elements and levels as you need them.

From spooky ghosts to scary gargoyles and fishlike mermans to beautiful mermaids, there is so much more to find in here. The abominable gazer might not be the thing you want to meet, but your heroes should definitely do so for an exciting and challenging fight that will be remembered! They should have their weapons ready, as with this set, they will have a lot of work to do!

notes.title: New DLC: City Exterior Tileset, Another World Heroine Generator 2 for MZ
notes.content:
This week, we have two new graphics packs ready for your games: a tileset to spruce up your city exteriors, and a whole new set of MZ generator parts for your heroines!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874590/RPG_Maker_MZ__City_Exterior_Tileset/

Let your heroes visit cheerful circuses and downtrodden neighborhoods with the City Exterior Tileset! Wataru nakanami has crafted a wide selection of tiles to help bring your cities to life. With tiles for markets, parks, slums, and more you can add more worldbuilding lore to your maps without ever writing a word!

Build a busy popup market with rough wooden signs hung above crates of fresh veggies and fish, while small carts full of candy hang out under colorful awnings. Or create streets full of shops with decorative metal signs hanging off the building and large glass windows giving a peek at the goodies inside alongside townhouses. If your heroes need to explore the city’s forgotten areas, then make use of the cracked ground that reveals dirt under paved streets and piles of trash to limit where your players can walk. Trailer homes can find a place next to ramshackle buildings, with clothing lines strung above the paths. You can also make use of the sheet’s separate manhole and manhole cover, to let your players know that they’ll be exploring the sewer sometime in the future

Let your player know your game takes place in a not-so-distant past with a penny-farthing bike leaning its huge front wheel against a wall and old-fashioned cars parked on the street. More modern cities could make use of the large hospital and gas station signs, or decorate office buildings with billboards advertising makeup or vacations. And don’t forget to put a food truck near the city’s park!

This pack includes sample projects for both MV and MZ, so you can see how each tile can improve your towns. Create maps that truly feel lived in with the City Exterior Tileset!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1884910/RPG_Maker_MZ__Another_World_Heroine_Generator_2_for_MZ/

Get ready to update your heroines’ appearances with Another World Heroine Generator 2 for MZ! Gee-kun-soft is back with another MZ generator pack, this time offering up 42 new female generator parts to help you create the heroine of your dreams.

Choose from 5 eyes to add some new features to your heroines, then take your heroines to the salon to try out the 5 front hair and 5 rear hair options! Keep their hair out of the way with a braided bun or by pulling it back into a long ponytail, or cut it to shoulder length to make sure it doesn’t get caught in any weapon swings. Give your shy heroine bangs that cover one of her eyes, or use the slightly shaggy bangs to show that your character is too busy to waste time brushing her hair.

With 20 clothing options to choose from, outfitting your heroines has never been easier! Give your druid a shoeless green outfit to help them stay in touch with the earth, and let your speedy gunslinger move easily with a shoulder holster-inspired top. Or let them show off their personalities with a two-tone asymmetrical dress, elbow length gloves matched with thigh-high boots, or a lightweight dress with fluttering sleeves and hem. Give your players some hints about a character’s backstory with their outfit. Is the helpful mage with the red corset and fancy cape also a dangerous vampire? And once you’ve picked your heroines’ outfits, make sure to give them one of this pack’s 5 accessories to finish their look! Top an outfit with a ruffle headband or hairpin, or bring a magician’s appearance to life with a tiny tophat.

Along with all these generator parts, this pack also includes an adjusted female base to make sure the off-the-shoulder clothing options look the best they can. Bring your heroines to life with Another World Heroine Generator 2 for MZ!

notes.title: New DLC: Last Boss Pack Vol 3, Retro Future Music Pack
notes.content:
For our second release day of the year, we have some new tunes with retro sound, and a new collection of ready to go bosses for your game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1869750/RPG_Maker_MZ__Last_Boss_Pack_Vol3/

Bring even more flames and fangs to your battles with the Last Boss Pack Vol3! Gee Kun Soft’s latest battler pack focuses on a favorite enemy type for fantasy games: dragons! Add in new fights against two-headed terrors, armored behemoths, and lithe serpents with this pack.

With 10 unique enemies to choose from, you can find a suitable dragon for any location. Battle a green-scaled dragon to save a princess from a tower, or fight an aquatic serpent to keep it from capsizing your ship! Be careful when exploring mines since your heroes may stumble across a dragon with crystal claws and tail and a nasty attitude. Even the sky isn’t safe, with lightning-summoning dragons coiling and dancing through the clouds!

And if that wasn’t enough, the dragons also each come in a special variant: undead! Surprise your heroes with another fight against the same dragon they’ve already defeated, but this time it’s fresh from the grave with empty eye sockets and tattered flesh. Maybe the true villain has been bringing these dragons back to life, or cursed them to rage forever until they’re defeated. Each enemy also comes in a high-res size, so your heroes can face off against a huge dragon during the final fight! 

This pack also includes sprites for each battler, so your players can see just what they’ll be facing next! Have a large dragon stand in front of its gold hoard as a deterrent, or let an undead drake stalk your heroes as they explore an ancient ruin!

As a bonus this pack also includes images of the dragons attacking, perfect for putting some fear into your players before the battle starts! If you’ve been hoping to add some more dragons to your game, then make sure to pick up Last Boss Pack Vol3!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1869740/RPG_Maker_MZ__Retro_Future_Music_Pack/

Grab your hoverbikes and get ready to explore an incredible world with the Retro Future Music Pack! Joel Steudler’s latest music pack brings old-school sci-fi to life with 20 rocking synth tracks that cover exploration, dramatic cutscenes, and even combat! With a focus on instruments that bring a nostalgic synth feeling to each song, this pack is ready to bring any 90s cyberpunk or sci-fi style game to life.

Explore marketplaces lit with neon and full of all sorts of robotic customers while ‘Midnight Market’s drums and electric beats play in the background, and give your players a warning about possible dangers lurking in the alleys by switching to the less cheerful ‘Street Brawl’. Battle against cyborgs and hoverbike gangsters to the fast-paced beats of ‘Pedal to the Metal’ or roaring electric guitars of  ‘Rocket Racer’. Have your heroes hunt down a contact who is hiding life-or-death info in an underground nightclub to the toe-tapping rhythms of ‘Techno Trouble’ and then travel through high-tech teleportation stations with the chipper beeps in ‘Route 88’.

Even if your story isn’t focused on sci-fi, these songs could find a home in your game. Maybe your modern arcade could use some synth tunes to match the flashing lights and general cheer of the place, or your villain has the power to throw your heroes into a pocket dimension where fantasy and sci-fi meet! Give your game the perfect vibes with the Retro Future Music Pack!

notes.title: New DLC: Winlu Cyberpunk Tileset - Exterior, Combat Whooshes Sound Pack
notes.content:
It's the New Year, and it's time for New Releases! For our first release of the year, we have 2 superb packs ready for you: a new Exterior set to go with the Winlu Cyberpunk interior set, and a whole pack of amazing combat sound effects!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1857280/RPG_Maker_MZ__Winlu_Cyberpunk_Tileset__Exterior/

What might the future have in stock for us? Well, if you go by WinLu’s Cyberpunk Exterior Tileset Pack, it will be both dark and gritty but also progressive, with some preserved trees, impressive futuristic cars and many many neon signs!

With a wide and creative range of autotiles you will get the perfect base for diverse and engaging cities, with a broad selection of tiled floors and all different kinds of walls. Even if your game is “just” modern and not futuristic, you will find some very nice pieces you might want to use here!

The additional tiles fit the Cyberpunk theme perfectly with every kind of decoration you can think of. There are windows with darkened and lit versions, or even a pane with optional bullet holes for a really rough part of town. You can add gritty fire exit stairs to your multi story buildings and have some trash bins stand around in their backyards, as well as visit the local market to buy some fresh produce or futuristic guns… or both! Some parts of the city might be in worse shape with all different kinds of holes, visible pipes and broken concrete structures. And no matter which section of the town you are in, the blinking neon signs will help you navigate - or just make your city look a lot more alive. On top of the tileset sheets, you also get a huge number of different doors that could lead to many interesting places.

So go ahead and check out this amazing pack, you will not regret it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1857290/RPG_Maker_MZ__Combat_Whooshes_Sound_Pack/

Whoosh! says the great battle axe, as it is swung by your barbarian hero in the direction of your enemies.

Whoosh! is the sound the giant fireball makes, when your wizard channels his magical powers to cast this spell.

Whoosh! is also the sound of the arrow, shot by your hunter heroine, who tries to take her opponents out from the distance.

And while you can use that simple word to describe those sounds, it would be a lot cooler if each of them had their own distinctive whoosh, right? And wouldn’t it be even better if there were several sounds for all different kinds of weapons and attacks, to make your battles much more immersive?

The Combat Whooshes Sound Pack brings the sounds your attacks make to a new level! With 100 distinct types of swings, shots, castings and punches there is not much left to ask for and no matter if it is an elegant sword, a slow cast spell or a futuristic whoosh - maybe coming from a blaster - this pack has it! And all those small yet powerful effects will help to make your game as immersive as it can get. 

Whoosh! makes the torch, as it is lit up to be able to see something in the dungeon. Good luck, adventurer!

notes.content:
Want to see what can kind of games can be made only one month with RPG Maker MZ? We've released the 3 winners of our Touch the Stars Game Jam as free games on Steam!

The itsy-bitsy spider may have gone up the waterspout, but Berry performs a marathon of fantastic gameplay and amazing fun. Join this adorable arachnid on their adventure to find the tastiest of flies. Along the way you’ll dodge fire bugs, leap across platforms, and follow the dubious advice of questionable cockroaches. notes.title: MZ Battle Animation Showdown
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38018723/daeb1da78ffb649a17319b4cf2263f9015f3f561.jpg[/img]
To go along with our publisher sale, RPG Maker MZ has also been updated to the latest version! And included in those updates are two much anticipated upgrades to the Battle Animations tab:

Effekseer integration updated to the latest version!
The ability to use MV Style Frame Animations!

To celebrate, in conjunction with the Effekseer team, we’re hosting the MZ Battle Animation Showdown!

And what will you do for this contest? Making Battle Animations!

The contest will have two different categories, one for MZ Effekseer Particle Animations, and one for MV Style Frame Animations. You can enter one, or both.

Make the best animations you can using the rules below and see if you can take the prize!

[h3][b]How to Submit your Entry[/b][/h3]
Download the Template Project Linked at the bottom of the post.
After editing the Template Project for this event, please upload it using File → Upload to the Workshop from inside of RPG Maker MZ

When uploading, use the following Tags
Category：Resources, 
Resource Type：Animations, 
Flavor：Optional
Description: Please include a description of the participating categories, an introduction to your work, and a list of credits for the materials you used.

[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] To submit your animation to the contest, add it to the workshop as a MZ Project using the template included at the bottom of this post. (this submission should be an unencrypted project, not a deployed file).
[*] Place your animation in the 1st slot in the Animations tab of the database.
[*] You may add any materials to the project you need to showcase your animation. The judging will be done based on the preview in the MZ engine.
[*] You may only use user-created resources that are available for modification and commercial use. Proper copyrights and/or credits must be included in the entry.
[*] You can use your own resources, but you must include copyrights and/or credits.
[*] You may not create a character that infringes on third party copyright or trademarks.
[*] You reserve the right to delete your entry even if it has already been posted and voted on.
[*] You may edit your work and/or the description after posting (we may contact you for confirmation if the character has changed significantly since the original posting).
[*] Submissions including adult materials such as extreme violence and/or nudity will not be accepted.
[*] Only one Particle Animation entry and one Frame Animation entry per user.
[/list]
[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
After the submission deadline, our judges will determine the best of the best in each category. There will be separate 1st through 3rd place prizes for each.

[list]
[*] 1st Place: $50 Steam Wallet Code
[*] 2nd Place: $25 Steam Wallet Code
[*] 3rd Place: $10 Steam Wallet Code
[/list]
[h3]Bonus Particle Animation Assets from Effekseer![/h3]

As a special bonus, the Effekseer team has sent a special pack of Particle Animation assets, free for everyone! You are free to use them in your entry, or in your latest projects!

[h3][b]Contest Dates[/b][/h3]
The contest will [b]run from December 9th until January 3rd 11:59PM Pacific[/b]! Get your entries in before then!

[h3][b]Entry Template[/b][/h3]
The entry template is a RPG Maker MZ project stripped down to the bare minimum for smaller file size. You must use this as a basis for your submission. You can add any materials needed to highlight your animation (including enemy graphics and backgrounds for the animation preview).

[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qVGqKb6nixfUwnMliE4hOur8F-9G1HUD/view?usp=sharing  style=button]ENTRY TEMPLATE[/url]

notes.title: New DLC: Big Garden Tiles, Hero Music Collection
notes.content:
A new outdoors tileset with an amazing almost fairy tale style! Plus another epic soundtrack from Ayato Sound Create! Let's look at our latest releases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812330/RPG_Maker_MZ__Big_Garden_Tiles/

Have you been wanting to include a game section where your heroes shrink, but don’t have giant plants to help sell the illusion? Do you want to make a cute fairy village where they all live in mushroom houses? Then check out Big Garden Tiles! This tile pack contains tilesets to help add even more nature and magic to your maps!

With flowers that tower over your heroes and acorns the size of their heads, it’ll be obvious that they’ve fallen down the rabbit hole into a new and magical world! Giant beds of roses and tulips along with house-sized mushrooms let you create amazing towns for fairies and garden gnomes, and the included interior sets offer up some perfect furniture to decorate their homes. WIth all sorts of wooden cabinets (some that are still growing!) and beds with a selection of comfy blankets, you can make the forest home of their dreams for these magical creatures.

And if your game doesn’t include adventuring through overgrown parks? Then you could still make use of the normal-sized plants to make great gardens. Add some cheery daffodils to front yards, and show how lazy certain npcs are by covering their lawns with dandelions! Fairy rings made of colorful mushrooms could be used as teleportation spots, or just add some variety to your forests’ undergrowth with morels and chanterelle mushrooms.

Also included are sprites for gnomes and glowing fairies to add even more magic to your mushroom villages! Or use the stone gnome as a cute garden decoration - just be careful if you spot its eyes glowing red. A bright red hat is also included, giving you the option to dress your heroes up in something a bit more suitable when visiting a gnome town.

This pack comes with tiles sized for both Ace and MV/MZ, so you can use it in your preferred engine. Add some fun new tiny adventures to your game with Big Garden Tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812540/RPG_Maker_MZ__Hero_Music_Collection/

Add some more epicness to your games’ soundtracks with Hero Music Collection! Ayato Sound Create has crafted 25 BGMs to help you find the perfect tracks for a variety of scenes! To get your players excited to play right from the get-go, why not pick one of the energetic tunes as your title screen music? When those songs pop up again during battles or scenes, your players will know something important is going on!

With a variety of instruments used, you can easily give different parts of your cities their own tracks to put your players in the right mindset for where they are. An upbeat bass and guitar would be great for an outdoor market or port, while a quirky electronic song is perfect for an underground bar. Play soft piano and strings during your game’s calmer moments, when your heroes finally have a chance to catch their breath and share some secret feelings with each other. And when your heroes finally face the final boss, give them pulsing drums to get them ready for the fight of their lives!

This pack includes ogg, m4a, and mp3 file formats for every song, so you can easily add it to your game in any engine! Give Hero Music Collection a listen today!

notes.title: New DLC: Heroine Character Generator 2 MZ, World Music, Tyler Cline SciFi Music
notes.content:
Release day is here again, and this week we have three new packs to sink your teeth into! Heroine Character Generator 2 has made the jump to MZ, trot the globe with the first World Music Pack, and head to the stars with Tyler Cline's SciFi Music Pack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756680/RPG_Maker_MZ__Heroine_Character_Generator_2_for_MZ/

Bring your magical girls and modern fashionistas to life with Heroine Character Generator 2 for MZ! Gee-Kun-Soft is back with MZ generator parts to take your female leads from drab to fab! This pack’s 38 generator parts contain new accessories, eyes, clothing options, and hairstyles to help you make your heroines look just how you imagine them.

All new front and rear hairstyles let you give your heroines faces framed by luscious curls or bangs swept to each side. Let your tomboy tie her long hair up with a ribbon or cut it into a bob so that it’s easy to maintain. For your warriors with long hair, how about a thick braid to keep it out of the way during battle? And when the fighting is done and it’s time to party, let it fall loose in long flowing curls. Don’t forget to decorate it with the pack’s new accessories! Adorable cat ears with a small flower accessory or a fluffy bow on the top of her head can really show off your characters’ personalities.

And if you’ve been needing more outfits, this pack is for you! 20 clothing options offer all sorts of possibilities for modern worlds. Give your schoolgirl-turned-magical-girl a simple uniform for her day to day scenes and a sleeveless dress with stars on her skirt when she needs to take on some baddies! Fantasy games can also find a use for some of the dresses that would be perfect for wearing to fancy parties. Or have a scene where your heroine needs to dress as a maid to sneak into a noble’s mansion.

With 3 AccA, 1 AccB, 1 beast ear, 20 clothing, 5 eyes, 4 front hairs, and 4 rear hairs generator pieces, this pack is full of pieces to help create your heroines. Make sure to check out the Heroine Character Generator 2 for MZ pack today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1752311/RPG_Maker_MZ__World_Music_Pack_Vol1/

Are the default music choices not quite fitting your globetrotting adventure? Then give World Music Pack Vol.1 a listen! Northsound Inc has made a pack that can take your heroes on an adventure around the globe, with 26 BGMs that cover towns, dungeons, battles, and everything in between!

Battle against foes in different lands while exciting flutes or powerful strings cheer you on, and explore dangerous dungeons to steady percussion and curious strings. Wander open fields or busy towns to the lively tune of flamenco guitars, or take a break at a relaxing tea shop as calming strings play in the background. The addition of choirs to a few songs take them to the next level, inspiring awe in your players when they enter forgotten ruins or mystical sites.

This pack’s 24 MEs offer even more ways to improve your scenes’ soundscape, with tunes for resting at inns, finding items, battle victories and defeats, and more! Introduce a powerful character with a burst of taiko drumming or reveal a beautiful landscape with lutes and flutes. And 15 SEs make sure that you can make your menus' sounds match the rest of your game’s musical themes, with short Arabic and Japanese inspired  jingles.

So if your game focuses on adventures all over the world, needs some suitable tunes for exploring a desert, or just needs a unique soundtrack for your fantasy world, check out World Music Pack Vol.1 today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756670/RPG_Maker_MZ__Tyler_Clines_SciFi_Music_Pack/

Take your game to a galaxy far, far away with Tyler Cline's SciFi Music Pack! Tyler is at it again with a music pack perfect for those of us who dream of travelling through the stars. So put your spacesuit on and get ready to blast off with synth tunes!

This pack’s 13 BGMs cover a range of emotions to help you tell your space stories. Float through space to the relaxing tones of Andromeda or the otherworldly strings of Starlit Iris. Fight off enemy spaceships or alien creatures to the fast-paced beat of Calculated Assault, and try to avoid deadly laser blasts while Solar Flare’s electronic beeps warn you of the danger.

Don’t forget to take some breaks from all the exciting space travel! Pick one of the calmer tunes as background music for your space bars, or when your hero just needs to take a few minutes to look out the window to fully appreciate the stars. The softer melodies are the perfect backdrop when you want your player to realize just how big and empty space can be.

The pack’s songs come in MP3, OGG, WAV and M4A formats, so it’s easy to use them in your favorite engine! Make your game sound out of this world with Tyler Cline’s SciFi Music Pack!

notes.title: DLC: New Krachware Cyberpunk Tileset! New Minikle Dungeon Backgrounds!
notes.content:
Today we have two new packs, a 2nd Cyberpunk Tileset from Krachware, plus another Minikle background pack, plus several fixes to our Ancient Dungeons tiles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725790/RPG_Maker_MZ__Krachware_Cyberpunk_Tileset_Pack_2/

The future might be a bright and modern place… or gritty and dark. No matter which path you choose for your game, or maybe even a combination of the two, the Krachware Cyberpunk Tileset Pack 2 brings great materials to realize both.

There are two main themes available, a futuristic and colorful part that would make great spaceship interiors with all needed parts from beds to shelves and research equipment. The different colors make it easy to create distinguishable areas in the same setting, so you can easily spot whether you are at the medial bay or at the research area.

If you are in for a time skip, you will love this pack, as for nearly every single of these tiles, there is also a broken and weathered version, as if the areas have been lying around for many years without any care.

That brings us neatly to the second theme, the run down research facility exterior. With several external structures that have obviously not had their best days lately and some nature elements you can make a great environment that matches the interior after the time skip… or a complete new planet for your heroes to land on and explore. So if you are up for some futuristic shenanigans, this pack is a must have! Coming with A3, A5, B and C, there is a lot to see and use in here for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1680960/RPG_Maker_MZ__Minikles_Background_CG_Material_Collection_Dungeon_part01_B/

After spending ages exploring dangerous dungeons and caves, it can be a nice change of pace to let your players head outside and enjoy nature with a walk in the woods. Minikle's Background CG Material Collection "Dungeon" part01 B is here to help bring that moment to life with beautiful backgrounds! Minikle’s newest background pack focuses on forests and forest ruins that are perfect for creating a dungeon atmosphere outdoors.

This pack is made up of 78 amazing images to help your players really imagine that they’re deep in the woods or stumbling across a long-forgotten ruin. Have your players step off the beaten path and into tall grasses to explore a lush forest. When they find a clearing, will it contain an enormous tree with an opening in its trunk or will the clearing reveal an overgrown temple?

The backgrounds also come with a few variations to cover different weather patterns and times of day. Turn normally peaceful woods into a creepy dungeon by using the foggy night version, or show just how bad an idea it was to steal the temple’s jewel but turning the sky an angry red that dyes all the plantlife purple. Some of the images could also double as battlebacks, so that even in battle your players know they’re still lost in the woods.

Each image comes sized for 816×624 and1280x720 screen size, making it simple to get the image to fit your game whether you’re using a 4:3 or 16:9 resolution. So if you’re ready to take your forest introductions to the next level, check out Minikle's Background CG Material Collection "Dungeon" part01 B today!
